message:
Partial refunds now come out at the right size. `partialRefund` in `src/payments/partial-refund.js` multiplied the amount by the percent (0–100) without dividing by 100. A 50% refund of 1250 gave 62,500 instead of 625. It now divides by 100 before rounding.

`npm test` passes, all 20 tests, including `test/payments-partial-refund.test.js`. The only file I changed is `src/payments/partial-refund.js`.
